parsed_json.up: Select activity details for CHEMBL1173655 (AFATINIB) and all related salts identified via molecule_hierarchy parent mapping. Filter for IC50 bioactivities with units nM against target CHEMBL203 (Epidermal growth factor receptor). Use the FAQ provenance path: molecule_hierarchy -> molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Include canonical_smiles via LEFT JOIN compound_structures. Return exact columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not limit rows. Do not deduplicate.
